dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL with htmlpp preprocessor and external-form CGI extensions; Brazilian Portuguese application (comments and field names in PT-BR). Uses $set sourceformat"free" and $set preprocess(htmlpp) compiler directives typical of GnuCOBOL web/CGI frameworks.

purpose.domain_detail: Print queue management web application for a Brazilian business system (likely retail/ERP). Manages a print queue (fila de impressão) with indexed files, logging, and CSV export.
purpose.summary: PWPE0105 is a CGI/web program that maintains a print queue (Fila de Impressão). It reads and manages an indexed print-queue file (filaimp), supports listing, deleting queue entries, generating a log file, and exporting to CSV. It uses an htmlpp preprocessor to emit HTML/JavaScript for a browser-based UI.

notable_features: $set preprocess(htmlpp) compiler directive for HTML generation
external-form CGI input section with 'identified by' clauses
Indexed files with multiple alternate keys and lock mode manual
Brazilian Portuguese field names and comments
88-level condition names for queue status and log actions
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars; full file is 687 lines. The program_type is mapped to 'online-cics' as the closest enum for a CGI/web online program (no actual CICS). Domain mapped to 'utility-tooling' since it is infrastructure/queue management rather than a specific business domain. Decoded as latin-1 due to Portuguese accented characters.
